headline: Cross-module candidate-structure identity check against the independent, Lee & Neville 1967-cited known_answer_amines set in amphora-molecule-generator: H0_REFUTED_CANDIDATE_STRUCTURE_MISLABELED. n_candidates_checked=5, n_genmod_matches_found=5, n_identity_mismatches=1 (['IPDA']). For IPDA the signed KPI's candidate_smiles ('CC1(CC(CC(C1)N)C)CN') canonicalizes to C9H20N2, a DEMETHYLATED HOMOLOG missing one ring methyl relative to real isophorone diamine (CAS 2855-13-2, C10H22N2, per Lee & Neville 1967). Baseline internal-consistency re-derivation of the signed monomer/methyl-capped Morgan(r2,2048)/Tanimoto NN values is exact for all 5 candidates (ka_baseline_all_exact=True), isolating the defect to candidate structure identity, not the featurization pipeline. Recomputing NN Tanimoto with the STRUCTURALLY-CORRECT SMILES for each mismatching candidate: classification_flips=False (impact={'IPDA': {'signed_nn': 0.16666666666666666, 'corrected_nn': 0.16666666666666666, 'flips': False}}).

hypothesis_evaluation.h0: Every signed candidate_smiles string in the Phase-0 Tanimoto-NN novelty KPI is a correct structural representation of the named hardener, per an independent hash-lockable ground-truth structure set.

independent_ground_truth_source.note: Definitional known-answer set. expected_active_nh is hand-checkable from the structure; AHEW is then the exact definitional quotient M/n_activeH with M re-derived by RDKit from IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weights. These test the INSTRUMENT, not any commercial product claim.

non_circularity: Independent ground-truth source (amphora-molecule-generator known_answer_amines, citing Lee & Neville 1967) was authored for a different purpose (AHEW/amine-value instrument testing) by a different audit lineage; not derived from or party to any amphora-molecule-novelty receipt. Baseline Tanimoto-NN re-derivation independently confirms the featurization pipeline itself reproduces the signed values exactly.
purpose: Test whether the 5 signed candidate_smiles strings in the Phase-0 Tanimoto-NN novelty KPI actually represent the named industrial epoxy-amine hardeners they claim to be, using an independent, already-hash-lockable ground-truth structure set from a different module (amphora-molecule-generator), not the same asserted structures re-checked circularly.
